name: Murders In The Rue Morgue
source:
A short visual novel based on Edgar Allan Poe's novel of the same name. The game only contains some parts of the novel. 
[From [url=https://lex-lex.itch.io/murders-in-the-rue-morgue] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
根据埃德加·爱伦·坡的同名小说改编的短篇视觉小说。游戏仅包含小说的部分内容。
[来自[url=https://lex-lex.itch.io/murders-in-the-rue-morgue] itch.io[/url]]
